overview.text: A modern academic environment that develops humanistic knowledge and linguistic and geospatial skills, connecting study with advanced technologies and community needs. The faculty offers modern interdisciplinary programs that combine academic knowledge with practical application, supporting the preparation of graduates qualified for the labor market.

programs.duration: not found (page 10 says 'Information will be added soon'; not stated on faculty page). Degree level: Bachelor's.
programs.focus: Interdisciplinary program integrating geospatial sciences, GIS, remote sensing and AI-based data analysis. Objectives: collecting and analysing spatial data, GIS applications, AI in urban and environmental planning, decision support. Key study areas: field and digital surveying, GIS, remote sensing, cartography, spatial databases, AI applications, geographic data management.
programs.careers: GIS, digital surveying, urban planning, telecommunications companies, spatial analysis, remote sensing, smart cities, geographic data centers.

programs.duration: not found (page 10 says 'Information will be added soon'; not stated on faculty page). Degree level: Bachelor's.
programs.focus: Develops English language skills, written and interpreting translation, and intercultural communication. Objectives: specialised translation, professional communication, linguistic and cultural analysis. Key study areas: written and interpreting translation; medical, legal, literary and audiovisual translation; applied linguistics; discourse analysis; English literature; research and intercultural communication skills.
programs.careers: Translation, teaching, media, language editing, tourism, public relations, international customer service, cultural and diplomatic institutions.

three_slide_bullets: Faculty of Arts offers two Bachelor's programs: Geomatics and AI; English Language and Translation.
Geomatics and AI covers GIS, remote sensing, digital surveying and AI-based spatial analysis.
English and Translation covers written, interpreting, medical, legal and literary translation.
Graduates target GIS, urban planning, smart cities, translation, media and diplomacy careers.
Program duration, credit hours and first cohort year are not yet published.
